captions.detailed: A wall-console air conditioning unit with a shallow rectangular light-gray body. The front face features a large, inset intake grille with horizontal slot ventilation. The unit is equipped with a rotating air discharge flap on its top surface and a sliding filter drawer behind the front intake grille.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a low wall-console air conditioning unit. It should include a main housing body, a top air discharge flap that rotates on a revolute joint, and a front filter drawer that slides out prismatically.
captions.factory: The code constructs the AC unit by building a base housing using a box primitive with a hollowed front recess. It creates a revolving discharge flap using a thin box located at the top outlet, connected via a revolute joint. The filter drawer is modeled as a box with a front grille face containing patterned slot cuts, linked to the main body via a prismatic joint.
